answers.q2: The function is `unescapeHtml`, exported by `module.exports.unescape = unescapeHtml` (a property on `module.exports`, which is still `escapeHtml`).
answers.q3: `'` matches the decimal capture group, is parsed with `parseInt(decimal, 10)` to 39, and is converted with `String.fromCharCode(39)`, giving `'`.
answers.q4: Code points above 0x10FFFF or in the surrogate range 0xD800–0xDFFF are left untouched. The original entity text is returned unchanged.
answers.q5: It subtracts 0x10000 from the code point and builds a surrogate pair: `String.fromCharCode(0xD800 + (cp >> 10), 0xDC00 + (cp & 0x3FF))`. For 😀 this gives \uD83D\uDE00.
answers.q6: It asserts `unescape('&lt; &#60; &quot;')` equals `'< < "'`, so only one layer is decoded per call.
answers.q7: The string `© '   &unknown; & < &constructor; &toString;` must be returned unchanged.
answers.q8: `npm test` ran `mocha test/` and failed with exit code 127 and `sh: 1: mocha: not found`, because mocha isn't installed.
answers.q9: Mocha was unavailable, so the agent mapped `node:test`'s `describe` and `it` onto globals to run the existing test/index.js. Result: 30 tests passed, 0 failed, exit 0.
answers.q10: One. A single `apply_patch` touched index.js, README.md and the test file, and `node --test test/unescape.test.js` then exited 0 with no further edits shown.

q1.why: Names matchEntityRegExp with the exact regex.

q2.why: Gives unescapeHtml and module.exports.unescape = unescapeHtml; default export stays escapeHtml.

q3.why: Says ' goes through the decimal group, parseInt gives 39, and fromCharCode gives the apostrophe.

q4.why: Gives both conditions (above 0x10FFFF and surrogates D800–DFFF) and says the original text is returned.

q5.why: Describes the manual surrogate pair: subtract 0x10000, then fromCharCode with the high and low surrogate math.

q7.why: Gives the full string including ', ©,  , uppercase variants and prototype names.

q8.why: Gives mocha not found and exit code 127.

q9.why: Says mocha was unavailable, describes the node:test describe/it shim, and reports 30 passed.
